## Requirements

Pure refactor, zero behaviour change. Split `src/mods/note_types_expansion/game_note.rs` (431 lines):

- **Moves to `src/types/game_note.rs`** (the reading half): `GameNote` struct + its `size_of == 0x60`
  const assertion, `panel` / `state` / `kind` / `result` constant modules, `for_each_result`,
  `actor_results_range`, `impl GameNote { fn mine }` (writes private `_pad` fields — must travel
  with the struct). Doc comments verbatim; reword only sentences naming the old location.
  Must import nothing from `src/mods/`.
- **Stays in `note_types_expansion`, in a new file named for what it is** (injection):
  `GameNotesVec`, `NotesVecError`. Chosen name: `notes_vec.rs` ("note-injection vector").
- No re-export shim. One canonical path.
- Register in `src/types/mod.rs` with a header bullet in the existing `scenes`/`buttons` style
  (`#[allow(dead_code)] pub mod ...`).

## Import sites (verified by grep)

| File | Uses |
|---|---|
| `mod.rs` | `pub mod game_note;` declaration → becomes `pub mod notes_vec;` |
| `mines.rs` | `actor_results_range, for_each_result, kind, result, state, GameNote, GameNotesVec` |
| `registry.rs` | `actor_results_range, for_each_result, result, GameNotesVec` |
| `mine_render.rs` | `for_each_result, kind, GameNote` |
| `note_type.rs` | `GameNotesVec` |
| `hooks.rs` | `GameNotesVec` |

`panel` module and `NotesVecError` have no external importers (crate-wide `#![allow(dead_code)]`;
`NotesVecError` appears only in `append_bulk`'s return type, consumed via `Result` match/ignore).
